methodology.targetVocabulary: One preferred lexical form per eligible lemma. Utility tiers are a product preselection, not acquisition ages.
methodology.segments: Global segment statistics are preserved, but the active research queue is generated from Rebulo-priority targets only.
methodology.validity: All coverage is exact concatenation of complete visible brick readings. Letters are explicit general-mode operations only.
methodology.candidateSearch: Whole Lexique entries whose complete IPA pronunciation exactly equals an uncovered useful segment.
methodology.gain: Useful Rebulo gain is primary; full Lexique-style target gain remains secondary context.
methodology.researchPriority: The automatic queue prioritizes useful Rebulo coverage, candidate plausibility and segment reuse. It never constitutes visual validation.
methodology.visualCaution: Lexical exactness never implies imageability, spontaneous naming, age suitability, or clinical validation.

firstWaveSimulation.caution: Simulation phonétique uniquement : les briques virtuelles ne sont ni activées ni validées visuellement.

candidates.label: oie

candidates.label: or
candidates.visualConcept: Deux petits lingots d'or accompagnés d'une pépite brute, sans monnaie ni texte, pour évoquer la matière or plutôt qu'un objet précis.

candidates.label: tee
candidates.visualConcept: Un tee de golf planté dans un petit carré de gazon avec une balle posée dessus, le tee restant clairement visible et central.

candidates.label: anse

candidates.label: as

candidates.label: heure

candidates.label: art
